notes: Recorded 21 distinct master's programmes (the page shows 22 entries because MSc in Electrical and Computer Engineering appears under two colleges; the page text says 20 master's programmes) and 20 PhD programmes (the page text says six PhD programmes but lists 20 by college). The recorded lists are the full lists on the official programmes page and equal the first-pass lists.
The page also describes two dual master's routes (Johns Hopkins Carey Business School and Arizona State University); they are not listed as separate programmes and are not recorded.
The page says one PhD programme has eleven optional concentrations but does not name the programme or the concentrations.
